title: Lozano Law Office Donates 100 Turkey Plates to Three Laredo Schools
excerpt: The Law Office of Sergio Lozano donated 100 turkey plates to teachers, staff and students at three Laredo schools last week, plus whole turkeys to a local ministry helping families for Thanksgiving.
content:
The Law Office of Sergio Lozano, PLLC, visited three Laredo schools last week as part of a Thanksgiving outreach effort, donating 100 turkey plates to be shared among teachers, staff and students, according to the firm.

The schools were Lyndon B. Johnson High School, Alma Pierce Elementary and Heights Elementary. The office also donated whole turkeys to Grupo Amor Ministerio de Amor y Restauración, a local group that provides meals and support to families who need extra help during the holiday season.

The firm said the visits were a chance to spend time with the school communities and thank the teachers, staff and students who contribute to Laredo throughout the year.

Sources: Law Office of Sergio Lozano, Nov. 23, 2026.
